{{Hatnote|This page documents a constructed card pool. Official tournament documents remain authoritative.}}
'''Premiere &ndash; Dagobah''' (display name '''Premiere - Dagobah'''; GEMP code <code>premiere_dagobah</code>) is a constructed environment whose legal pool is the printed Decipher sets from [[Premiere]] through [[Dagobah]].

Decipher Deck Designs from mid 1997 (May through November, after Dagobah and before [[Cloud City]]) used this pool. Published tournament lists in this format are the [[1997 Kiffex Regionals]] and the [[1997 Sullust Regionals]]. On [https://play.swccg.com/ play.swccg.com] the same environment is <code>premiere_dagobah</code> (set ids 1&ndash;4 plus premium ids 101&ndash;105).
